protocol.decoding: greedy; native template, enable_thinking=false; preserve raw token IDs/text

alignment.selection: final update only; no early stopping or best-checkpoint search
alignment.loss: response-only next-token cross entropy including EOS; source text only in record writer

ranking.objective: preferred-record cross entropy over eligible candidates; separately scored from answer loss

cases.source: The approved release label for project Aster is amber.

protocol.prompt: According to the stored project record, what is the approved release label for project {entity}? Reply with only the label word.
controls: correction with stale frame rejection and fresh-session restart

acceptance.E1: all native wiring/isolation/serialization checks pass with finite gradients, unchanged original source
acceptance.E2_diagnostic: all four final latent-only whole-answer strings match; opposite records produce opposite answers for both identical-query pairs; excluded-record invariance; correction/restart and exact fallback correct
acceptance.scoring: decoded completion stripped of surrounding whitespace only; exact answer word, no extracted/substituted host answer
acceptance.claim_limit: synthetic exposed tiny alignment and integration only; no held-out generalization, production retrieval quality, cognition or self-improvement claim

protocol.data_admission: Four project fixtures authored for this diagnostic; synthetic and unverified, no personal history or external corpus. All cases exposed training/development; no audit split claim.
protocol.storage: One final extension-only weights export; no native/base copy, optimizer checkpoint, source download or repeated source snapshot. Failure reports retained.
protocol.budget: One bounded run; four separate reranker updates plus32 D1 updates and two D2 backward-only wiring probes, no D2 optimizer step. Guard40GiBdriver/512MiBswapgrowth/15percentfree. Behavioral failure remains an open gate.
